Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: B.Sc./Diploma in Engg and Technology (3 years)/B.E./B.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or any allied field.

content_sections.heading: Panjab University Lab. Technician Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Lab. Technician at Panjab University.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Lab. Technician post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Lab. Technician post?
faq.answer: The offered salary for the Lab. Technician post is Rs. 30000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a B.Sc. degree or a Diploma in Engineering and Technology (3 years) or B.E./B.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or any allied field.

faq.question: Q6. What is the date of the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at the Panjab University office in Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates bring for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.
